extracted.intended_audience: CIA management and staff responsible for implementing OMB Circular A-44 (Physical Security Division, Special Assistants)
extracted.subtask_description: Internal CIA memorandum describing implementation steps for OMB Circular A‑44, focusing on recruiting and staffing the GSA guard force to reduce overtime and ensure proper building coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recruit guards to bring force to authorized strength
rubrics_metrics.description: An aggressive effort is being made to recruit guards for the CIA GSA force in order to bring the force to authorized strength. This effort should reduce the amount of overtime which is now expended to effect proper coverage of CIA buildings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Memo states belief that recruitment efforts during January through June 1971 will partially alleviate the current overtime situation. Point of contact: Chief, Physical Security Division for further information or questions.
